entities.name: USER
entities.rationale: End user initiating web traffic to the application.

entities.name: ROUTE 53
entities.rationale: DNS service resolving domain requests (https://omon) for the end user.

entities.name: ALB
entities.rationale: Application Load Balancer distributing incoming traffic to compute resources.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service managing containerized workloads.

entities.name: SPOT
entities.rationale: EC2 Spot instances executing microservices workloads within the cluster.

entities.name: SNS
entities.rationale: Amazon Simple Notification Service handling messaging and notification publishing.

entities.name: SQS
entities.rationale: Amazon Simple Queue Service storing asynchronous message queues from microservices.

visual_connections.description: User resolves https://omon hostname via Route 53 DNS.
Route 53 routes incoming traffic to the Application Load Balancer.
ALB forwards HTTP/HTTPS requests to the Spot instances cluster.
Spot instances distribute load internally across microservices MS1, MS2, and MS3.
Microservice MS1 managed by EKS pushes messages to SQS queue.
Microservice MS1 running on Spot publishes notifications to SNS.
